formNote: Hot/cold reads each team's last three weeks, weighting the latest game most and factoring in margin.

changes.text: The Jaguars are now running hot.
The Bears are now running hot.
The Commanders have warmed up after a rough stretch.
The Vikings are no longer unbeaten.
The Broncos took over first place in the AFC West.
The Panthers took over first place in the NFC South.
The Bills are now running hot.
The Raiders have warmed up after a rough stretch.
The Buccaneers are now running hot.

bullets.text: The Chargers are the NFL's only winless team at 0-7, having now lost seven straight games.
The Ravens have lost three straight to fall to 4-4, and both Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley left their latest game hurt.
The Panthers lead the NFC South at 3-4 after two straight losses, and the 3-5 Buccaneers are running hot with a +27 differential.
